issues.description: The problem statement and UML/tests require public getters for each attribute (e.g., getLectureName(), getNumberOfInscribedStudents()), but the solution implementation declares some getters as private (getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents()). This visibility mismatch would prevent external code or tests from accessing these getters and contradicts the tasks asking students to implement getters for each attribute.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getters for all attributes public (e.g., change getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() to public) so their visibility matches the UML/problem description and allows external tests and code to access them.
